title: edge-quant-boarding-checkin-mar09-2027
content:
Meeting: Edge Quantization & Model Onboarding — weekly check-in
Date: 2027-03-09
Owner: Aisha Khan (notes)
Attendees: Aisha, Marcus, Sofia, Jonah, Priya (brief drop-ins from infra: Omar)

Purpose: quick sync on progress for the edge-quant pilot, surface blockers for onboarding new open models (mistral-7b-edge and open-ggml-mini), and review eval outcomes from last weekend's runs. Keep it short — call was 30 minutes.

Summary of decisions
- Continue with two parallel branches: (1) low-bit 4-bit PTQ pipeline for Mistral-like family, (2) FP16->int8 hybrid quant path for GGML family. Both to be packaged as reproducible infra images for Private customers.
- Roll experimental default batch_size heuristics into the probe harness (Marcus to push changes by 3/12).
- Stop trying the current KV-cache-snapshot approach for edge runtime (too large) and explore prefix-only caching + compressed vectors (Sofia + Jonah).

Status updates
1) Experimental results (weekend runs) — Marcus
- Models: mistral-7b-edge (base), open-ggml-mini (baseline)
- Quant settings tested: 4-bit PTQ (GPTQ-like), 8-bit symmetric, 6-bit mixed + FP16 activations.
- Latency (p95) on Jetson Xavier NX (single request, seq_len 128):
  - mistral-7b-edge 4-bit PTQ: 280ms (p95), throughput ~3.2 tokens/s
  - mistral-7b-edge 8-bit: 340ms, throughput ~2.6 tokens/s
  - open-ggml-mini int8-hybrid: 190ms, throughput ~4.7 tokens/s
- Quality (approx BLEU/QA proxy on prompt-suite-21):
  - 4-bit PTQ: relative score 0.92 vs fp16 baseline
  - int8-hybrid: 0.97 vs fp16 baseline
Notes: 4-bit PTQ shows larger quality drop on longer-context prompts (>=256 tokens). Int8-hybrid performed best for microcontrollers-like CPU+NPU setups.

2) Onboarding checklist progress — Sofia
- Packaging: container recipe for edge runtime v0.9 created (Dockerfile + minimal entrypoint). Image size ~780MB compressed. Still above target (target <600MB).
- Licensing: confirmed permissive model license for open-ggml-mini; Mistral family requires attribution - legal loop opened (CON-4821).
- Tests: unit tests for quant transform landing in PR 312 (linked). Need integration harness for runtime memory smoke tests (Jonah).

3) Eval automation & regressions — Jonah
- Added small evaluation harness to run our prompt-suite against quantized variants. Results are stored in s3://redwood-ml/quant-evals/2027-03-07/ (internal path).
- Hooked up basic regression alert: if quality drops >5% relative to the pinned baseline then the model fails onboarding. Current 4-bit runs fail that check for long-context prompts.
- TODO: implement per-prompt weighting so that critical prompt categories (legal, code, math) have higher influence on pass/fail.

Action items (owners + due dates)
- Marcus: Merge batch_size heuristics and perf-probe flags to quant-tools repo, add README snippet describing heuristics. Due 2027-03-12. (Git PR: /pull/312)
- Sofia: Investigate image size reduction strategies (multi-stage builds, strip symbols, alternative base image) and prototype one reduced image. Due 2027-03-16.
- Jonah: Build integration memory smoke tests for edge harness and add to CI matrix (simulate low-RAM device with 4GB cap). Due 2027-03-15.
- Priya: Draft internal one-pager summarizing license obligations for mistral family and recommended attribution language for customers. Due 2027-03-11.
- Aisha: Write a short experiment plan for compressed prefix-only KV cache exploration and schedule spike (2 days) with Sofia & Jonah. Due 2027-03-12.

Blockers / open questions
- Memory explosion with full KV-snapshot approach on device — need algorithmic approach for compressed prefix or eviction heuristics. (Ongoing spike)
- Which model variants should get first-class support in Redwood Private: single-shot lowest-latency vs highest-quality quant? Need product guidance. Ask PM for prioritization before next week.
- Acceptance threshold for edge onboarding currently too binary — discuss softer rollouts (A/B) for Private customers.

Notes to self / fragments
- Brainstorm: store prefix vectors in half-precision then apply per-chunk PCA (k=32) to reduce footprint — lossy but maybe stable for short-term context. Need to simulate reconstruction error.
- Consider a small policy flag: "edge_cache_mode": [none|prefix_pca|evict_oldest] to give customers immediate controls.
- Snapshot of command used for local perf run: 
  ./quant-tools/bench --model=./mistral-7b-edge-q4 --batch=1 --seq=128 --device=jetson --warmup=20 --iters=500 --metrics=p95,mean,throughput

Quick numbers (for paste into slack)
- Mistral-7b-edge q4 p95: 280ms | quality: -8% long prompts
- Open-ggml-mini int8-hybrid p95: 190ms | quality: -3% overall

Next meeting agenda (2027-03-16)
- Review reduced-image prototype and CI memory smoke tests
- Results from 2-day compressed prefix spike (if completed)
- Product decision on first-class supported variants for Private
- Decide fallback policy for failing onboarding models (auto-fallback -> next compatible quant level?)

Appendix / links
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quant-tools/pull/312 (batch heuristics)
- Jira: ML-889 (edge quant onboarding epic)
- Legal ticket: CON-4821 (mistral license review)
- Eval s3 prefix: s3://redwood-ml/quant-evals/2027-03-07/ (internal)

End of notes.

-- Aisha
